title: London Council Tax Increase
summary: The London council has announced a tax increase for households earning over £60,000. The council will also increase rent for West London shops by over 100%, which may lead to closures. The tax increase and rent hike are part of the council's efforts to manage its finances. The council's decision has been reported by multiple outlets. The exact number of households and shops affected is not specified. The council's actions are intended to generate additional revenue.
summary_points: London council to charge £60,000+ households more tax
West London shops face closure due to over 100% rent increase
Council's decision aims to manage finances and generate revenue
Tax increase and rent hike affect households and businesses
Exact number of affected households and shops not specified
